summary: A member answers a reporter by explaining what the measure would cost the town.
realLife: Chris Smith cited New Jersey families’ federal tax bills when explaining his 2022 vote against the Inflation Reduction Act. He had wanted the measure to lift the cap on deductions for state and local taxes.
inGame: needs: a bill-specific local cost available to the press-comment reply.
gates: The cost to this government has been established.

turns.what: The member sends the reporter the town's estimate after the interview.
turns.pulledBy: The town clerk was still checking the figure when the reporter called.
turns.writesBack: The estimate has a source and a delivery date separate from the initial comment.

turns.what: A resident brings a tax return to the district office and asks where the member’s example applies to their household.
turns.pulledBy: The example depends on itemized deductions and the resident used the standard deduction.
turns.writesBack: The office corrects its reply to the resident and identifies which households its public example covers.
